_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits mid-ladder with cancelled extremes and mild momentum drift, so skilled HOLD into adjacent Complacency is the consensus path unless a breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLDs toward Complacency; narrative supplies no forward phase or direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds ~45-55 and 30d momentum stays mild drift with no spot-ETF revival and no funding flush
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G into the 30s with ETF flows pinned (stay/deeper Anxiety) or spot ETF bid returns and 30d momentum flips positive (Disbelief)
